gate: fresh 60s sustained quiet and envcheck; journaled physical-core reservation; continuous monitor

nominee.retention: actual built candidate after complete compare; separate from actual choice

fixed_rule: one eight-process run; no retry until promotion or passing result

exposure.windows: first and last seven; all chronological samples retained

sampler: one non-inlined entry for all conditions, same public slice loop
predictions: Slow baseline only at original selector locations supports caller-location effect.
Ranking tracking call count on identical location supports count-dependent regime.
Baseline falling from early to late with fixed address/count/warm cadence supports accumulated-exposure effect.
If all conditions run fast baseline and no prior slow regime returns, caller/stack/code context remains unresolved.
limitations: Retaining selector vectors and nominee perturbs later allocation history.
Original scratch allocation may have been replaced before retention; N96 controls use no active scratch.
The common sampler changes original qualification caller/stack context.
Diagnostics cannot replace uninstrumented acceptance or waive any failed cell.
Even first exposure samples follow ordinary arena timing; a flat exposure trace cannot reject an earlier qualification transient.
reset: zero once per block/location; no reset between samples
block_order: cyclic rotation by process modulo3; all sampling is post-arena
duration_evidence: Each sample emits actual integer timed_batch_ns and ns_per_call; auditor verifies exact declared-call normalization.
